description: Manage WSL distros from the sidebar: start/stop, live CPU and memory, default distro, export/import, shutdown, and editing of .wslconfig and /etc/wsl.conf.
welcome:
No WSL distros found.
[Install Distro](command:wslManager.install)
[Import Distro](command:wslManager.import)
[Refresh](command:wslManager.refresh)
command.openWindow: Open in New VS Code Window
config.wslExePath: Path to `wsl.exe`. Empty = auto-detect (`wsl.exe` on Windows, `/mnt/c/Windows/System32/wsl.exe` when the window is connected to WSL).
config.autoRefreshSeconds: Interval, in seconds, for automatically refreshing the list while the view is visible. `0` disables it.
config.metricsIntervalSeconds: Sampling interval, in seconds, for the CPU and memory of an expanded distro. Sampling only runs while the distro is already running, expanded, and the view is visible.
config.defaultUser: User for terminals opened in a distro. Empty = the distro's default user.
config.clickAction: What clicking a distro in the list does.
config.clickAction.expand: Expands the distro to show its details and configuration files.
config.clickAction.terminal: Opens a terminal in the distro (expand it with the arrow).
config.clickAction.window: Opens a new VS Code window connected to the distro (expand it with the arrow).
config.clickAction.none: Does nothing; use the buttons and the context menu.
config.showManagedDistros: Show distros created by Docker Desktop, Podman, and Rancher Desktop (`docker-desktop`, `podman-*`, ...). They are labeled and protected by extra warnings either way.
config.confirmDestructiveActions: Ask for confirmation before terminate, shutdown, and unregister.
